title: Your scenario title

paragraphs: Replace this story with your own scenario.
intro.imageAlt: A forest map with alternative routes between a cabin and a destination
intro.caption: One journey, interchangeable ways to travel.
intro.task: Assign each member and connect the planner, strategy interface, and walking strategy.
intro.concept: Strategy lets a context use interchangeable algorithms through one shared interface.

classes.label: TravelStrategy
classes.description: The contract for every route-planning algorithm.

methods.label: planRoute(destination): Route
methods.description: The operation every travel strategy must provide.

classes.label: WalkingStrategy
classes.description: Plans a route using paths suitable for walking.
classes.imageAlt: Walking boots on a forest path

classes.label: JourneyPlanner
classes.description: Delegates route planning to its selected strategy.
classes.imageAlt: A compass and a route map

fields.label: strategy: TravelStrategy
fields.description: The interchangeable algorithm used by the planner.

methods.label: planJourney(destination): Route
methods.description: Asks the selected strategy to produce a route.

hints: Both the interface and the concrete strategy have a planRoute method.
The planner owns the strategy field and planJourney method.
WalkingStrategy implements TravelStrategy. JourneyPlanner uses TravelStrategy.
